## What's free

Free web services: 750 instance-hours/month, 512 MB / 0.1 CPU, spin down after 15 min idle; free Postgres expires after 30 days; 5 GB/month bandwidth

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://render.com/pricing> before relying on this.

## Notes

Hobby bandwidth was cut from 100 GB to 5 GB/month in Apr 2026.

## Plan

- `stack/`: a root module whose `platforms` output follows the [platform contract](../../docs/architecture.md#platform-contract), so [`hybrid/`](../../hybrid/) picks it up
- `freelunch deploy`: one service per app through the provider's API, from the app's Compose file (see [Northflank](../northflank/) for the pattern)
